message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (Standard Edition)** | Step | What Happens | Key Points | |------|--------------|------------| | **1. Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. | • If the first card is a special card (e.g., Draw Two, Reverse, Skip, Wild, or Wild Draw Four), treat it as if it were drawn from the draw pile and apply its effect immediately. | | **2. Turn Order** | • Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | • The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. | | **3. Playing a Card** | • On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile.
• If you have no playable card, you must draw one card from the draw pile. | • If the drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **4. Special Cards** | • **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses the direction of play.
• **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color to match.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | • A Wild Draw Four can only be played if the player has **no** card that matches the current color. If challenged and found to have a matching card, the challenger draws four cards instead. | | **5. Winning a Turn** | • When you play your last card, shout “UNO!” if you have one card left. | • Failure to say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn results in a penalty: the player who missed UNO must draw two cards. | | **6. Winning the Game** | • The first player to reach **500 points** wins the game. Points are tallied after each round:
 • Sum of all cards left in opponents’ hands (number cards = face value, Draw Two/Reverse/Skip = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50).
 • If you finish a round with **exactly 500 points**, you win immediately. | • If no one reaches 500, play continues until someone does. | --- ### Quick Reference Cheat Sheet | Card | Value | Effect | |------|-------|--------| | Number (0–9) | Face value | Play if same color or number | | Draw Two | 20 | Next player draws 2, skips turn | | Reverse | 20 | Change play direction | | Skip | 20 | Next player skips turn | | Wild | 50 | Choose new color | | Wild Draw Four | 50 | Choose new color, next player draws 4, skips turn (only if no matching color) | --- #### Common Variations (Optional) | Variation | How It Changes the Game | |-----------|------------------------| | **Stacking** | Players can stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards to pass the penalty onto the next player (e.g., two Draw Twos = 4 cards). | | **No Challenge** | Wild Draw Four can be played at any time without the risk of being challenged. | | **House Rules** | Some groups add “Draw One” cards, “Skip All” cards, or other custom rules. | Feel free to adapt the rules to suit your group’s preferences!
